asset.name: ImportWorkflow
asset.description: The staged import covering file selection, parsing, field mapping, validation preview, execution, progress, partial failure reporting, and a downloadable result summary.

requires.reason: File intake, progress, and retry are shared.
Field mapping is a form and uses the shared runtime.
The validation preview is a shared table.
Long work survives navigation by living in the shared task registry.

signatureMoment.description: Every rejected row is shown with the reason beside it and can be corrected in place, so a failed import becomes a short correction pass rather than a start-over.
